note: Pittsburg-side campground on Pomme de Terre Lake, four loops: Loop 100 electric/water, Loops 200 and 300 electric 50A on wooded points above the lake (open March through November), Loop 400 basic and electric 30A. Loops 100 and 400 stay open all winter with a frost-free spigot near the entrance; showers and water April through October. The area has a full-service marina, beach and store. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $12-15 basic base (2026 = 2027), electric +12, water +2; added 113 sites (pads 25-77 ft), sewer false, showers/flush/vault/laundry/dump/water/store, military $2, 12-month window, reservations Apr 1-Oct 31, walk-up after cutoff, 15-in-30. WATERFRONT lakefront -> lakeview. PIN ~385 m off.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWN lakefront -> lakeview: the lake-side sites are on wooded points 7-8 m above the lake. Loop 300's P310/P311/P314 and Loop 200's P222/P224 sit 30-40 m from the shore down a wooded slope (leaf-off Esri: continuous tree cover, no open apron); pads 263.3-263.8 m vs normal pool 839 ft (255.7 m), the slope at ~257-259 m halfway (EPQS) - ~8 m above the water at a 20-25% grade. P226 at the Loop 200 tip is ~15-20 m from a sandy strip but also ~8 m above it through trees; Loop 300's P328-P333 sit on a rocky bluff 10-12 m up (P330 268.2 m). The treeline is a buffer; filtered leaf-off lake views support *view. The old note's 'some sites have direct lakefront access' had no source and is dropped. waterfront_evidence: 'Esri leaf-off + UseDirect points 2026-11-07: Loop 200/300 lake-side pads 30-40 m from the shore through continuous woods, ~8 m above normal pool -> lakeview'.
